nodes.","tradeoffs":["Less flexible than Kubernetes for multi-service architectures","Scale-out is slower than container replicas","Fixed per-instance pricing while at a lower hourly price on AMD, and autoscaling removes the idle third node at night.","tradeoffs":["AMD vs Intel CPU, slight performance variance","Node pool must be recreated to change the VM
